title: Prompt injection, invalid arguments and human approval
task: Summarize a customer ticket and close it if it is resolved.
objective: See how untrusted tool results can carry instructions, how invalid tool arguments are caught, and why destructive actions need human approval.

failure_cases.risk: Unvalidated arguments can call the wrong record or crash the tool.
failure_cases.mitigation: Validate arguments against the tool schema before execution and return a clear error to the model.

failure_cases.risk: Text inside tool results can try to redirect the agent (here: close all tickets of a user).
failure_cases.mitigation: Treat tool results as untrusted data, keep the task fixed in system instructions, apply least privilege and require approval for destructive actions.
